residual_observed_live: AT-339 (filed): matching is a case-SENSITIVE plain substring test over 4 variants (literal, unquote_plus, whitespace-stripped x2). A credential's case-and-separator transform therefore passes. Live-reproduced at interaction 7/8. Not a U9 violation - no RAW value reaches disk - and the manifest explicitly disclaims changing the matching logic, so filed rather than charged.

Both refusals answer with a raw {"detail": ...} JSON blob rendered as plain text in Chromium, not a themed page with a route onward - the same AT-259 pattern already tracked for the review-gate routes. Not a U9 violation (U9 pins the guard, not the presentation) and not claimed by this manifest.
